What’s inside the number

Ours ends finished.
Doors, delivery, install.

Most quotes stop at the steel. Ask any builder what’s not in theirs. Ours is one number plus local sales tax.

  • Galvanized steel frame — 14-gauge standard, 12-gauge upgrade
  • 29-gauge panels — 26-gauge for commercial buildings
  • Doors — (2) 10′×10′ garage doors and a walk-in door in the package
  • Delivery and professional install by our crew
  • 4″ concrete slab — 3,000 PSI, monolithic, 8″×8″ turn-down footing, when you bundle it
  • Price locked in writing for 6 months
